title: Zero-Length Recorded Run
statement: Let $R$ be a multi-tape Turing machine, let $yes$ and $no$ be states, and choose a base position for each work tape and a natural-number radius. If configuration $a$ has every work-tape head within that radius of its base position, then the run from $a$ to itself in zero steps avoids both distinguished states at every time strictly before its endpoint and satisfies the head-position bound at every time through its endpoint.
hypotheses_covered: A base integer position for each work tape and a natural-number radius
Every work-tape head in $a$ is within the radius of its base position
